I had a similar one but it has only the rough, scrubber side, unlike this one which has both a scrubber side that will scrub off dead skin, as well as a SOFT side that you can polish your skin with after scrubbing. It feels really nice to flip over to the soft, gentle washcloth-like side after using the loofah side on my back. Disappointed.  The loofah part is only a small part of the scrubber (it takes up the middle third of the scrubber on one side).  The rest of the scrubber is very soft and did not exfoliate well at all.  Would not recommend.

Good, well made product. Honestly, for a full-grown man, such as myself, it can be nearly impossible to actually get the mid to upper part of your back clean. This nice, discreet back and body scrubber does the trick. It's made of very durable material, which means that it will probably be around for a long time.  One side of the back scrubber is rough, which is great at exfoliating dead skin. The other is soft, which worked well with my body soap (good sudsing action)  All-in-all I recommend th

reviews.t: It is nicely made, but a couple of flaws for me
reviews.x: It is nicely made, but a couple of flaws for me. It is to long for me. I am petite and have to grip above the hands, which I don't mind, but I cannot get the pressure I need to actually scrub my back. It simply moves across my back for a light coating of soap. I like more of an exfoliating scrub that you can get with something firmer. Not what I expected it to be. But it is nicely made if you like a light wash.

reviews.t: Solid construction, not rough enough though
reviews.x: Guess it's okay for others but wasn't harsh enough for me. It gets my blood flowing pretty good and is long enough for me to do my back and use it as a wash cloth. One side is for cleaning, the other is for polishing.  The loofah has enough length to it so there's no need to contort your body into nearly impossible positions to use it. I love this back scrubber! It makes getting your back so easy! It's made well and the straps are so easy to use to get my back and shoulders. It’s durable and well-made and is the perfect width which keeps it from rolling up like most of the other ones do.  I can’t believe I used a scrubber on a stick before I found this!
Lasted a whole 2 weeks before starting to tear. Threw it out

I bought this product, which I found to be fine, not amazing, but works.  Unfortunately, I kept getting email after email from the seller asking to leave feedback.  So - here it is - the product is as expected, but comes with far too many solicitation-type emails.  In their defense, they did say they were not going to email me after this last round of feedback requests.

reviews.t: Initially I really liked the product but I left it in my bathroom ...
reviews.x: Okay product! Initially I really liked the product but I left it in my bathroom and was away for a couple of weeks and by the time I returned there was all kinds of things growing on it. Not sure why this happened even though it was dry when I left it. Disappointed.

reviews.t: No more stapling my loofah to the wall and rubbing my back on it like a grizzly bear on a pine tree
reviews.x: What can I say? This is the Cadillac of loofah stuff. No more stapling my loofah to the wall and rubbing my back on it like a grizzly bear on a pine tree. Life now has a demarcation point - before this loofah, and everything after it. Epic.

reviews.t: The loofah does not cover the full LENGTH of the strap.
reviews.x: Well, I WAS warned.  Another reviewer complained that the loofah covered only one third of the strap.  I mistakenly took that to mean one third of the width, not one third of the length.  Looking at a picture of the product posted by a different reviewer, I could see no indication of that characteristic.  I concluded that the critical reviewer must have either received a defective product or that the product had been redesigned subsequent to that individual’s procurement.  Upon receipt of my own

reviews.t: This thing is just great. I have impingement syndrome in my shoulder and ...
reviews.x: This thing is just great.  I have impingement syndrome in my shoulder and this makes it real easy to scrub my back.  I holds plenty of my liquid soap so I end up just using it instead of a washcloth.  It is longer than some others I have tried so a real benefit to this 6'2"+ guy with long arms.  It is sturdy and holds up well to the pressure I place on it.  Thanks for making such a good product and at a reasonable price. Shipping was fast too so I didn't have to wait.  Thank you again Caroli

Fir the last couple of years my husband has been complaining about not being able to reach his back awhile, so when I saw this one I thought that this is what he needed.  The first time he used it he got out of the shower telling me how great his back was feeling He said I needed to try it so I tried and I was pleasantly surprised at how good it made your back,  So if you want to feel like you just got up from a massage table, you need to buy one of these

reviews.t: That work well when it presses again my back -- the thicker loofah part due to more expansion will make better contact w
reviews.x: This scrubber is working very well for me, so far. Because the loofah portion will expand more than the cotton part after soaking with water, so it expand outward after getting wet. That work well when it presses again my back -- the thicker loofah part due to more expansion will make better contact with my back, so it scrubs my back well. If the loofah part can be longer, I would've given it 5 stars.

The product came quickly and I was excited to give it a try. LOVE IT!!  The quality of the material was wonderful and it definitely exceeded my expectations. I like the easy of use and it was great for those hard to reach area on my back. It exfoliated wonderfully and left the skin feeling polish and rejuvenated. I would definitely recommend for yourself or for a gift. A+

reviews.t: I have limited flexibility and mobility thanks to a spinal ...
reviews.x: I have limited flexibility and mobility thanks to a spinal cord injury, and this product lets me get my back clean and almost in a massage kind of way. Paid under 10 bucks on lightning special, but worth up to 20-30 for my situation. The grab handles also provide hooks on both ends to hang it in the shower to drip dry. Its nothing too fancy, but it does the job well.

OMG, I love this thing! It's a shower back scratcher-scrubber-sponge thingamagiger all in one!!! I'm thinking I'm gonna have to get my fiance one, because he keeps trying to steal it. And it smells like guy body wash. Actually, I may buy a couple more just so I'll have an extra when this one needs replacing. Omg, I'm never going back to the poof thingies!

I think this product could go a long way if they did some more to make it last longer. It was looking bristles the first week of use. Maybe 7 uses... And it's not a well designed product in terms of spread range. It doesn't cover most your back when you wash. Only a small section making out hard to wash quickly.

Bought one for me and one as a gift. Love the product. It's well made and does exactly what the description says it will do. Appreciate the choice of textures for buffing and for scrubbing, especially on hard to reach places like my back.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.t: Somwhat difficult to rins soap completely from loofah.
reviews.x: Only had the chance to use it once.  The feel on skin was great, and I expect to like it better as I get more accustomed to manipulating the strap during use.
It does the job however it has been awkward for me as my previous one was longer and easier to use. I wish this one was maybe six to eight inches longer .

reviews.t: Loofah is too stiff and hard. Used several times ...
reviews.x: Loofah is too stiff and hard.  Used several times and does not soften up.  May work OK with liquid soap but impossible to put bar soap on this.
The loofah and cloth are too different in flexibility as materials and you're not able to get a good scrub after a couple of uses.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it effective and easy for reaching and scrubbing their back, especially those with limited mobility or long arms.
Several reviewers praise the dual-sided design with a scrubber side and a soft polishing side.
Some reviewers say it is not rough or exfoliating enough for their preference.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with stitching coming loose or the product tearing within weeks.
Some reviewers note the loofah material covers only part of the strap rather than the full length.
